environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'prod-services' behind Kong Ingress Controller (v3.4) with a custom plugin chain. The kong-request-validator plugin is configured with a protobuf schema definition that enforces field-level constraints via CEL expressions on the transcoded JSON body before proxying to the gRPC backend. Specifically, the 'username' and 'request_id' fields have a pattern constraint of '^[a-zA-Z0-9._@-]{1,64}$' applied at the gateway's grpc-web transcoding layer. The validation occurs on the deserialized protobuf fields after HTTP/JSON-to-gRPC transcoding. Note: the plugin operates on the transcoded representation, not raw protobuf bytes, and rejects requests returning HTTP 400 before they reach the upstream pod. Additionally, a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts ingress to the pod exclusively from the kong-proxy pods in the 'kong-system' namespace on port 50051.
